title: CI/CD Pipeline Automation for Microservices
raw_text: FinServ Solutions seeks expertise in automation and tooling to build a robust CI/CD pipeline for our microservices architecture. Current stack includes Kubernetes, GitLab, and ArgoCD. We need automated testing gates, deployment rollback mechanisms, and monitoring integration with Datadog. Security scanning must be integrated into the pipeline.
requirements: CI/CD pipeline design for Kubernetes microservices
Automated testing gates with quality thresholds
